sources.title: Wild Red Fox
sources.creator: T.Voekler
sources.rights: CC0; verify file-specific metadata before redistribution
sources.view: right-facing fox at rest; mirrored design cues only, not source-identity match

analysis.construction: Long cranium-to-nose taper, substantial ear cartilage rooted behind skull, chest ruff physically merges with shoulders and long narrow forelegs, small eye in deeper brow orbit.
analysis.material: Warm rust upper coat, cooler charcoal-brown lower limbs, cream chin and ruff; tail has a brush silhouette and pale far tip.
analysis.microdetail: Rooted whiskers near muzzle, fur growth reverses across crown, ear cartilage and cheek, separate soft/short rostrum fur.
analysis.light: Soft side-lit fur plane transitions, under-jaw shadow and dark eye recesses.

crops.observation: Available photographed preview confirms an eye much smaller than the cranial volume, nose tip small relative to muzzle and a tapered profile; this box is whole-source only, not an independently measured semantic crop.
crops.implementation_rule: Apply small near eyelid, small black nose and eye-to-nose connected pencil tracts. DO NOT claim source-pixel likeness.

sources.title: Fox - Early Morning Gaze
sources.creator: Darren Gwatkin
sources.rights: artist-owned; technique study ONLY, do not trace/export image data
sources.view: portrait-close side profile fox eye, muzzle, cheek

analysis.construction: One small amber focal eye, upper-lid black sepia contact held in larger eye socket, long nasal bridge, lower muzzle darker than upper cheek.
analysis.material: Many individually directed warm gray, pale ochre, russet and chocolate strands optically build coat instead of solid polygons.
analysis.microdetail: Eyelid darkest near pupil, small discontinuous catchlight, short hairs near muzzle, longer along cheek/ruff and soft whiskers.
analysis.light: Warm russet upper plane fading to gray/cream lower plane with shadow at their interface.

crops.observation: Public preview eye sits in dense changing-direction hair with much darker upper eyelid than lower eyelid and short glint; approximate whole-image region, not pixel-registered data.
crops.implementation_rule: The full fox close-up eye must be under one seventh of the visible cranium width; use upper-lid, iris, pupil and lower fur as distinct pencil marks; no cartoon white oval.

sources.title: How to Draw a Fox in Coloured Pencil
sources.creator: Bonny Snowdon
sources.rights: artist-owned educational text and artwork; technique-only, no line-art/file copying

analysis.construction: Work structure, small eye and ear BEFORE fur, then muzzle and ruff; whiskers last.
analysis.material: Polychromos burnt ochre/terracotta/sepia plus ash grey/beige/cream layered at low pressure on Pastelmat tooth, without a single opaque white face sticker.
analysis.microdetail: Small upper-lid sepia contact; warm gray tiny nose over indigo, fur fans out from ear base, whicker pores and fine pale marks drawn last.
analysis.light: Darkness built progressively inside sockets/behind ear, light-over-dark accents selective.

crops.observation: Source is written multi-stage studio tutorial. No source-image crop is imported; general process guidance only.
crops.implementation_rule: Order structure -> eye -> ear -> head color -> tiny nose/velvety muzzle -> neck ruff -> whiskers; preserve editable stroke paths and paper-resident tooth.

sources.title: Fox Cub Foot – Wildlife Close-up
sources.creator: Perverted? Photographer not independently verified
sources.rights: unknown, technical observation only; no redistribution, no imported image pixels
sources.view: ground-level front feet with two visible legs and individually tufted toes; fox cub, not adult proportion source

analysis.construction: Two narrow lower front legs swell only around the lower metacarpal and toe pads; ankle insertion narrows above the front digits; toes and claws separate across the front ground plane.
analysis.material: Dark near-black legs with warm brown toe tips and hair tip edges, small uneven dark nails.
analysis.microdetail: Four close but distinct toes; narrow exposed nails; micro hairs converge on each digit, not uniform long strokes down a black boot.
analysis.light: Very dark velvet upper leg with smaller amber highlights only at root/foot; soft contact shadow beneath pads.

crops.observation: Public preview directly examined at tool resolution, but source-relative pixel crop not obtained; bbox is full image. Fox cub feet differ from adult seated pose; use only construction grammar.
crops.implementation_rule: Wrist narrows before gradual toe fan; retain digit creases, dark claw slits, small warm toe hair and non-uniform fur flow; no rectangular boot hem.

sources.title: Red Fox Appearance – Fur-covered Forepaw
sources.creator: Wildlife Online; individual photograph creator not confirmed
sources.rights: unknown, observational study only; no photo pixels or tracing committed
sources.view: dorsal paw and fur, non-pose matched

analysis.construction: Canine metacarpus transitions into densely furred adjacent toe knuckles and a hidden lower pad; direct front view may show only a narrow claw slit and darker toe tips.
analysis.material: Coarse dark brown guard hairs overlay warm brown fine undercoat, with fur wrapped around toe curves.
analysis.microdetail: Each toe has its own curved center ridge and short pointed hair, rather than evenly spaced straight vertical lines; padded digits taper below wrist.
analysis.light: Very restrained top-plane highlights, rich darker toe creases.

crops.observation: Public standalone image preview inspected; exact image bounds and source-pixel measurements unavailable.
crops.implementation_rule: Use separate narrow optical carpal plane, four low-pressure toe-root creases, short fine hairs, dark claws; no photo filter.

feature_targets.geometry_rule: At max ~24 local units width the focal near eye is attached to brow and tear-trough planes; far canthus remains occluded and >75% inside head silhouette.
feature_targets.source_observation: Realistic eye is a small subordinate element within the russet and black socket, not an oversized stylized orange ellipse.

feature_targets.geometry_rule: Connected narrowing upper rostrum and gray/cream lower jaw, with small less-than-30-unit curved nose, not a bulbous rounded rectangle.
feature_targets.source_observation: Muzzle tapers continuously in perspective with a small soft-edged dark nose.

feature_targets.geometry_rule: Ear cartilage masses overlap skull, thorax and ruff interlock, forelegs have thin paws; pale tail tip physically at end of brush.
feature_targets.source_observation: Warm rust top, pale cream ruff and dark limbs require nonuniform hand-layered marks, not uniform hatch or synthetic noise.

feature_targets.geometry_rule: Seated fox has 2 nearly vertical weight-bearing thin forelegs ending in outward splayed 4-toed paws; the rear hock is a low folded lateral mass rooted underneath the rump, NOT a third straight upright black leg.
feature_targets.test_view: 1× full fox and 2.15× actual Storybook forepaw/hock in both 16:9 and 9:16, before/after crop critique
feature_targets.source_observation: Adult/cub reference photos corroborate curved toe/ankle transitions and fur-wrapped compact paws; neither is a pose-matched seated canonical source.

five_axes.topology: Rear hock intersects orange rump and reaches ground; forepaw stays connected to slender upper leg; 4 toe knuckles and 3+ tiny claws per front paw.
five_axes.flow: Short fibers travel carpus→paw front and rotate around claw pits, not uniform diagonal hatch.
five_axes.weight: Dark metacarpal marks; controlled warmer browns on highlights; strong only under toe creases/claws.
five_axes.rhythm: Asymmetric digit widths and staggered rooted fur tracts.
five_axes.texture: Actual CP-F1 dry pencil three pressure families/seeded undercoat, no image/photo/shader fill replacement.

feature_targets.release_status: blocked — semantic art improvement not pixel source-registered, independent artist approval pending
